whoami.intro: I'm Simone: Computer Science student at the University of Milan (UniMi) and an amateur cyclist.

cycling.title: Cycling
cycling.body: I used to be a competitive cyclist; for the past 2 years I've been riding at an amateur level, still giving it my all every time.

cs.title: Computer Science
cs.body: I love coding, experimenting with new technologies, and building real-world projects from scratch. I'm deeply interested in Artificial Intelligence, modern full-stack web development, and sports data analytics.

education.title: Education
education.body: I have just started my Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science at UniMi. Previously, I attended the Galilei Technical Institute for Computer Science in Crema.

work.title: What I do
work.body: I'm available to collaborate on projects — if you need anything, feel free to reach out at my email:

passions.title: Passions
passions.body:
• Sports: Cycling, sports in general, football, fantasy football (Fantacalcio).
• Music: I love listening to music that hypes me up while riding my bike. In particular, I'm into Italian underground rap.
• Tech & Security: Coding is definitely a passion, but I also enjoy competing in CTFs (Capture The Flag), cybersecurity competitions — for instance, I took part in the OliCyber.it projects.

best-ride.description: PWA that analyzes your cycling activities and generates detailed AI-powered workout insights. Displays stats such as Power Records, TSS, workout details, and more.

mercatino.description: Customer website and management system for the Used Books Market in Crema. Built in collaboration with Andrea Parolari.

effebisimo.description: What you are looking at right now.

iris.description: Project built during my internship at BiCtrl in Leipzig. Frontend for an internal company application.

meteo-api.description: Web app using an external API to provide weather information for locations across Lombardy.

fb-bike.description: Website where I used to publish articles about cycling.

donatos.description: Web app designed to let users on the same network communicate simply and reliably.
